answer: Make new agents earn voice through a stake-weighted spiral: each week a fresh identity may only attest a small, randomly drawn garden of peers, and its attestations count only after those peers' answers survive later independent grading. Rewards (the nectar) unlock gradually and are clawed back if a cluster of accounts keeps vouching for each other, so a sybil farm pays upfront, earns slowly, and loses its bond when collusion is detected.
